investigation_notes.Recent Events: Three AnonymousLinkCreated events by the same user between 2026-02-01T18:40:00Z and 2026-02-01T18:52:30Z referencing personal SharePoint objects.
investigation_notes.Description: A large spike of 920 SharePoint file downloads (baseline 10) was observed from Jonas Laitis originating in Vilnius, Lithuania at local time ~21:05. The user's role in Manufacturing does not align with many of the downloaded paths (Legal, Board/Strategy, Marketing, Client lists), and the volume represents ~92x the 24-hour baseline; the user also created multiple anonymous links shortly before the downloads. Because of the significant volume spike, clear role-to-data mismatch, and evidence of anonymous link creation, this activity is treated as High Priority for further investigation.
